test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The Social Justice and Empowerment Ministry of India, which caters to the welfare of the backward classes and those with disabilities, saw _______ increase in the allocation in the Union Budget 2022 - 23.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Social Justice and Empowerment Ministry** of India saw a** 12% increase** in the allocation in the** Union Budget 2022 - 23.**
 
• This increase in allocation is a** positive development** as it will help the ministry in implementing various **schemes and programs** for the welfare of backward classes and people with **disabilities.**
 
• The Social Justice and Empowerment Ministry is one of the key ministries of the Government of India and is responsible for the welfare of the **disadvantaged sections **of the society.
 
• The ministry has various schemes and programs like **scholarships, skill development, rehabilitation**, and assistive devices for persons with disabilities, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On February 1, 2022,** India's Minister of Finance, **Nirmala Sitharaman**, unveiled her fourth budget, the **Union Budget for 2022.**
 
• The **NDA government **lead by Narendra Modi is in its **second term **and this is its** third budget.**
 
• The day before the budget, on **January 31, 2022**, saw the release of the** Economic Survey for 2021–2022.**
